core_memory.club_experiences: Joined the Computer Science Society during freshman year. Weekly meetups, discussions on new technologies, sharing projects, and industry speakers. Helpful for learning about concurrency and containerization.
core_memory.vr_ar_club: Attending since sophomore year. Hands-on club with a VR lab in the engineering building. Hosts demos of VR/AR projects, including an AR tutor for advanced math. Inspiring and supportive environment for emerging tech enthusiasts.
core_memory.student_radio_events: Attends open-mic nights at the student-run radio station. Features singing, poetry readings, and stand-up comedy. Reminds you that people have hidden talents beyond their academic work, like a friend from Distributed Systems who performed an acoustic set on stage.
core_memory.campus_spots: Central lawn is a popular hangout spot with student organization booths. Freebies like stickers and candy are often offered. Annual Tech Fest takes place on the lawn, featuring project teams, live demos, and recruiters. Particularly important for engineering and CS students.
core_memory.dorm_life: Lived in ‘The Engi-House’ dorm for two years, specifically for engineering majors. Legendary late-night coding sessions in the common lounge. Occasional intensity due to stressed-out engineers. Potlucks, Netflix, and talent shows for stress relief and socializing.
core_memory.outreach_volunteering: Volunteers at ‘Tech for Good’ day, helping local high school students learn programming and problem-solving. Runs mini-workshops on web development and Python. Rewarding to see younger students gain confidence and excitement about STEM fields.
core_memory.senior_week: Upcoming experience of Senior Week, a series of events leading up to graduation. Includes a formal dance, carnival, and cap & gown photos. Heard it’s bittersweet, filled with laughter, nostalgia, and a sense of the journey ending. Excited and anxious about the transition to post-graduation life.
